checks.description: Every shipped unit validates against bullhorn-schema.json (cwi-bullhorn/v1) via the test's mini-validator: required keys unit_id/date/headline/body_verbatim/claims/truth_gate/amplify present; claim items each carry text/source/date; dates are YYYY-MM-DD. Brand rule: the official CWI logo is present on every shipped visual asset (index.html, announce.html) — no page renders without the badge.

gate.py passes the shipped real unit (exit 0, PASS) and rejects (non-zero) a unit with a sourceless claim and a unit containing a banned phrase. Rules enforced: claims without {source, date} fail; claim dates after the unit date fail unless scheduled:true; banned unverified phrases fail; claimed-but-unsourced numbers fail. test.py asserts all three gate verdicts.

Only verified CWI facts ship in the first unit: Hugging Face dataset BlackLansky/cwi-catalog live 2026-09-15, public, 5 files (catalog.jsonl 24 track records, products.jsonl 18 product records, README.md, validate.py, .gitattributes), metadata-only (text and code files only — no audio), That Boy Hi Hat / Frederick MD / Cumulative Web Inc positioning. No deny-list language anywhere outside gate.py/test.py, which legitimately carry the deny list.

EQUIP / CONFIGURE / APPLY steps are copy-paste operable: every URL referenced (unit file, schema, card, page, HYPE hub, first-unit dataset, contact) is live, and the APPLY block is a valid gate.py verification + verbatim-amplification snippet.

evidence.broadcast-schema-conformance: shipped unit passes the schema mini-validator in automated gate 1; logo.jpg present in index.html and announce.html
evidence.give-block-operability: give-block.md EQUIP/CONFIGURE/APPLY reference bullhorn.json, schema, item-card, page, hype hub, hp@cumulativeweb.com — all live per gate 2
evidence.truth-gate-discipline: test.py runs gate.py on three cases: real unit PASS (exit 0), sourceless-claim unit FAIL, banned-phrase unit FAIL
evidence.verified-facts-integrity: gate 1 asserts the HF URL, 24/18/5-file counts, the 2026-09-15 dates, and the CWI positioning strings; deny-list scan clean outside gate.py/test.py

self_evaluation.run: automated: bullhorn/test.py gates 1-5 evaluate the product against this rubric
